name: chat-manager-reload
description: Offers to reload the window after VS-code-chat-manager deletes a chat, or runs a queued prompt into one this window still has open, so the panel shows what changed.

chatManagerReload.signalFile.markdownDescription: Path to the tool's `data/reload-request`. Empty means `~/Tools/VS-code-chat-manager/data/reload-request` (and the old `~/Tools/chatrm/data/reload-request`, while that exists). Set this if `VS-code-chat-manager.ps1` lives somewhere else - `data/` follows the script, so the path moves with it. `chatinstall` prints the line to paste when it is not the default.

chatManagerReload.autoReload.markdownDescription: Reload without asking after a delete. Off by default: a reload restarts every extension in the window, so one taken mid-answer loses that answer. Never applies to a queued run, which can finish at any hour while another chat in the window is busy.
